method: Reviewed the full lesson, checkpoint, registered evidence sources, historical DATA entry and prior confidence review. Ran the six-check W6 verifier plus the retained seven-check review. Independently calculated the two-sided 95% intervals for 0 successes in 95 trials using the lesson's Clopper-Pearson and Wilson implementations, and opened NIST proportion-interval/sample-size and FDA adaptive-design guidance. Built 407 static pages and a 407-page search index, then inspected full-page light/dark screenshots at a 1300px viewport. No provider calls were made.

observations.trace: For 0/95 at 95% two-sided confidence, the lesson's Clopper-Pearson implementation returns approximately [0, 0.038086], while Wilson returns approximately [0, 0.038865]; this refutes a universal CP-wider-than-Wilson ordering. The revised prose distinguishes interval coverage properties from interval width and restricts ordinary percentile-bootstrap degeneracy to identical observations. The production render confirms centered layout, no horizontal overflow, Mermaid SVG, and no visible escape marker in both themes. One browser console error is a missing local favicon. All historical 40/40 figures remain clearly conditional on an IID Bernoulli illustration and are not treated as a population estimate.

limitations: The old 40/40 result remains a historical summary without per-run requests, responses, task mapping, or scorer and was not replayed.
The 0/95 pair is a deterministic counterexample produced by local interval functions, not an observed model evaluation.
This review did not run a sequential test, a multiplicity-controlled experiment, or any provider call.
